name: qmh-project-grading
description: Local Codex agents for preprocessing and grading PPE QMH paper-exposition group project submissions.

interface.shortDescription: Preprocess and grade QMH paper-exposition projects.
interface.longDescription: Provides local Codex agents for organizing Canvas paper-exposition project submissions into short group folders and grading reports, slides, and related materials against the active QMH project instructions and rubric. The 2026-27 project is not an R/Rmd data-analysis project.
defaultPrompt: Use the QMH project submission preprocessor for the latest paper-exposition submissions folder.
Use the QMH project grading agent to grade processed paper reports and slides.
Prepare concise feedback files for the QMH paper-exposition group project.
